jei.functionalresources.info.generator:
The Mycelial Generator burns mushrooms and water to produce Forge Energy (FE). One generator produces %s FE/t times the fuel's energy multiplier.

Generators touching on any of their six faces form a network. Every running generator in a network is boosted: Network FE/t = Base x N x %s^(N-1), for up to %s connected generators. Energy is pushed into adjacent cables and machines automatically.
jei.functionalresources.info.water: Water: a running generator uses %s mB every %s. The %s mB tank is filled with buckets (right-click or the bucket slot) or with fluid pipes.
jei.functionalresources.info.mycelium: Mycelium: every %s of running time the generator tries to turn a dirt block with air above it, within %s blocks, into mycelium. The first attempt has a %s chance. Each unsuccessful attempt adds %s, up to %s, so after at most %s attempts a conversion is guaranteed. After a success the chance %s.

jei.functionalresources.info.wrench_usag:
The Mycelium Wrench links Mycelial Generators that are not touching.

Right-click a generator to select it, then right-click another generator to link the two. Shift + right-click a generator to remove all of its manual links. Shift + right-click the air to clear the selection.
jei.functionalresources.info.wrench_scal: Linked generators join one network exactly like touching ones. Every running generator in the network counts towards N in Network FE/t = Base x N x %s^(N-1), so linking distant generators boosts all of them. Links to generators in unloaded chunks are kept but only count while both are loaded.

jei.functionalresources.info.creative_ge: Creative-only. Produces unlimited Forge Energy (FE): every tick it pushes power into all adjacent energy receivers (rate set by creativeGeneratorOutput in the server config), and cables or machines can pull unlimited FE from any side. Place it next to a Mechanical Separator to test without a power setup.

jei.functionalresources.info.separator: Separates resource wool into its resource and string using Forge Energy (FE). Hoppers and pipes insert from the top and sides and extract from the bottom by default; outputs are pushed into an inventory below. Configure sides and costs in the server config.
